thread:
anya: ran the weighted sweep for nf4-int8 last night. proposing we adopt a progressive reweight (weighted sweep cutover) instead of a straight promote. want to confirm auto-fallback rules and metric windows before we flip more traffic. config idea below.
matt: SG. which signals do you want to gate on? latency, semantic sim, safety, cost?
sylvia: include token_cost and user_satisfaction_rate too. and make sure we check sensitive slices (billing/legal/finance) independently.
diego: also think about sample-size guards — we shouldn't trigger on tiny slices. what's the immediate-fallback policy?
anya: initial thoughts: fallback if any of the following within a sustained window: safety_fail absolute increase > 0.15% OR semantic_sim mean drop > 0.02 (embedding cosine) OR p95 latency increase > 35ms OR cost_per_token increase > 12% relative. windows: require sustained failure over two consecutive 30m holds, except safety_fail which is immediate rollback on a single hit.
matt: I'd compare against a 24h rolling baseline and use a 30m hold_window per step. use Wilson CI for binary metrics, min effect size for continuos metrics to avoid noise. for small slices use bayesian smoothing.
sylvia: here's a compact rollout config we can drop into the console (yaml):
```
rollout:
  mode: weighted
  variants:
    - name: v2-int8
      initial_pct: 5
    - name: v1-fp16
      initial_pct: 95
  step_plan: [5, 10, 25, 50, 100]
  hold_window: 30m
  compare_baseline: 24h_rolling_mean
  metrics:
    safety_fail_rate:
      comparator: absolute_inc
      threshold: 0.0015   # 0.15% absolute
      immediate_trigger: true
    semantic_sim_mean:
      comparator: relative_drop
      threshold: 0.02
    p95_latency_ms:
      comparator: absolute_inc
      threshold: 35
    cost_per_token_pct:
      comparator: relative_inc
      threshold: 12
  sample_size_guard: 1000_requests_per_slice
  oscillation_protection: require_two_consecutive_failures_except_safety
  fallback_behavior: immediate_for_safety, otherwise step_back_to_previous_weights
```
diego: add: for oscillation protection, cap reweighting frequency to once per hour per route. and ensure rollback is idempotent (no partial partials).
matt: for A/B stats add p-value < 0.05 + delta >= min_effect_size (configurable per metric). also log full bootstrap samples to S3 for postmortem.
qa-bot: smoke check: flagged a regression on slice 'billing-roundtrip' at 10% weight — semantic_sim mean drop 0.025 vs baseline, p95 latency +12ms, safety unchanged. (detected 2887654335)
anya: ok pause ramp immediately. sylvia can you run targeted shadow + eval harness on that slice and attach prompt-level diffs?
sylvia: on it, spinning up 2h shadow with 100% sampled traffic for that slice. will run contrastive eval + token-level diff. expect results ~2887654400, will post short summary.
deploy-bot: canary update: v2-int8 weight moved 5% -> 10% at 2887654330 (triggered by step plan).
matt: :thumbsup: keep close watch on safety and the billing slice. if the semantic drop persists across the shadow run, revert to v1 and open an action item.
anya: ack — pausing further increases until slice clears. thanks team.
